# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sample file helper

# Run ars() for density f, store n samples (one per line) in path.
save_ars_samples <- function(f, n, path, seed) {
  s <- ars(f, n, seed = seed)
  writeLines(format(unclass(s), digits = 12), con = path)
  invisible(path)
}
